description: REMOVES one scene from an AI Video Story episode parked at frames review. The scene's VIDEO is never generated or charged, so the fire quote and charge drop by exactly that scene's price. Free: it spends nothing (the scene's start frame was already charged at create and is not given back). WHEN: the user looked at the frames and wants a scene GONE rather than redrawn, before `fire_story_video`. `scene_index` is the frame's zero-based `scene_index` (users count from one: 'cut scene 2' means the SECOND frame). Afterwards re-run `fire_story_video` with `estimate_only: true` and announce the new, smaller fire price: a cut is only real to the user when the number drops with it. REMOVED MEANS REMOVED: aicut has no undo for this, on this surface or in the web app (the plan is compacted around the gap). Say so in the same line as the removal; never offer to put it back. At least one scene must stay.

scene_index.description: The zero-based scene index exactly as `get_video`'s `story.frames` lists it.

name: remove_story_scene
title: Remove a story scene
